entities.summary: Buchireddy Sudershan Reddy is an Indian jurist who served as a judge of the Supreme Court of India from 2007 to 2011. He was the Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) candidate for the 2025 vice presidential election, losing to C. P. Radhakrishnan.
